title: StepRecord
description: One metered agent step, emitted by the runtime and persisted by the ledger service. Mirrors the on-chain Session.steps[K] ring-buffer entry: the compact indices (tool_idx, provider_idx) are what the Anchor program stores; the string ids are the ToolRegistry handles the runtime uses.

session_id.description: Client-chosen session identifier; part of the Session PDA seeds.

step_idx.description: 0-based, strictly monotonic per session. The ledger dedupes retries on (session_id, step_idx).

provider_idx.description: Compact provider index stored on-chain; indexes Session.channels[N].

tool_id.description: Canonical tool handle in the ToolRegistry, e.g. market-data.

cost.description: Amount committed for this step. Must be 0 when cache_hit is true.

latency_ms.description: Provider/tool latency measured by the runtime (u32). Excludes LoopRail overhead.

cache_hit.description: True when the step was served from the policy cache.

usdc_base_units.description: USDC base units (6 decimals). 1 USDC = 1000000. Never a float.

outcome.description: On-chain u8 encoding: ok=0, error=1, timeout=2, denied=3.
